faqs.question: How do I claim and ship a won Tesla vehicle or hardware product to my country?
faqs.answer: All physical Tesla vehicle wins (Model 3, Cybertruck, Model S Plaid, Roadster Founders) and physical hardware prizes appear inside your User Dashboard under the "Won Prizes & Shipping" tab. Simply enter your international destination country, full street address, and preferred freight method (Air Freight, RoRo Ocean Container, or Domestic Enclosed Carrier), then settle the itemized Processing Fee, Export Documentation Cost, and Insured Freight cost directly from your spendable wallet balance or by making a deposit.

faqs.question: How do Autonomous Fleet Staking Pools & TSLA Fast-ROI Stock plans generate daily returns?
faqs.answer: Apex Tesla Hub operates commercial autonomous Robotaxi fleets, luxury Plaid track rentals, and commercial V4 Supercharger Megawatt nodes alongside NASDAQ: TSLA liquidity strategies. Staking pools yield 14.8%–22.6% APY, while accelerated TSLA Stock Fast-ROI tiers deliver 24.5%–42.0% annualized returns over 7 to 30 day automated settlement cycles, paying dividends and matured capital straight to your USD vault.

faqs.question: Can I buy and sell fractional NASDAQ: TSLA Spot Shares anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes. Inside the TSLA Stocks hub, signed-in members can purchase live TSLA shares starting from $500 USD per order with instant execution against real-time quoted prices, track unrealized profit/loss (PnL), configure automated breakout/dip price alerts, and sell shares back into USD liquidity 24/7.

faqs.question: How do crypto deposits (BTC, USDT, XRP, BNB) work on Apex Tesla Hub?
faqs.answer: Deposit directly from your dashboard using our automated Web3 crypto gateways. Dedicated on-chain receiving addresses and memo tags are available for BTC, USDT (TRC-20 / ERC-20), XRP (XRPL), ETH, and BNB (BEP-20). Funds credit rapidly with zero platform processing fees and trigger an instant email confirmation receipt.

faqs.question: How does the Spin-and-Win Wheel & Max Scratch Card Tesla jackpots work?
faqs.answer: Registered members can spin the provably fair wheel (featuring two grand Tesla vehicle slices—Model 3 Highland & Cybertruck—plus cash rewards and Try Again slices) or purchase metallic Scratch & Win foils ranging from $50 up to the $8,000 Founders Roadster tier, which gives verified odds at winning a 2026 Tesla Roadster Founders or Model S Plaid.

faqs.question: What is included in Tesla Service & Mobile Ranger scheduling?
faqs.answer: We provide full bumper-to-bumper Tesla certified maintenance: High-Voltage battery cell impedance diagnostics, drive unit inverter service, brake caliper lubrication, 16V low-voltage Li-ion replacement, Bioweapon HEPA filter swaps, and suspension alignment—either inside our Apex Technology Bays or via Mobile Ranger dispatch to your driveway.

faqs.question: How long do custom 3M vinyl wraps and ceramic PPF last?
faqs.answer: Our clean-room wrap studio uses aerospace-grade 3M 2080 and Avery Dennison Supreme cast films sealed with a hydrophobic ceramic topcoat. Every installation carries a 5-year warranty against lifting, bubbling, or UV discoloration and typically protects OEM paint for 5–7+ years.

faqs.question: How does nationwide & international enclosed vehicle delivery work?
faqs.answer: Vehicles purchased in our Buy Tesla Showroom or won via promotions are transported in climate-controlled enclosed carriers or international insured containers. You receive a live VIN allocation, 40-point pre-delivery inspection report, checkpoint GPS tracking, and our 7-Day / 1,000-Mile 100% Money-Back Guarantee on showroom purchases.

faqs.question: Are rental fleet vehicles delivered with Full Self-Driving (Supervised) & Supercharging?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every rental across our Cybertruck Cyberbeast, Roadster Founders, Model S Plaid, Model X Plaid, and Model Y Performance fleet arrives unlocked with Full Self-Driving (Supervised) and complimentary unlimited Supercharging across all hubs.

faqs.question: Why must I sign in before accessing the Dashboard, Deposits, Store Checkout, or Staking?
faqs.answer: All financial balances, vehicle VINs, staking certificates, won prizes, and withdrawal permissions are isolated to authenticated customer vaults. Signed-out visitors can browse showcase pages, read public specs, and review FAQs, while signing in or registering unlocks full wallet, purchase, and investment execution.

faqs.question: What security protections & KYC verification standards protect my account?
faqs.answer: Every vault supports Hardware-Grade 2FA, a dedicated Wallet Transaction PIN, active multi-device session revocation, and streamlined identity KYC verification (Passport, Driver License, or National ID) to keep high-value vehicle orders and crypto payouts compliant.

faqs.question: What are the withdrawal rules and processing timelines?
faqs.answer: Crypto and wire withdrawals are processed within 15–45 minutes once approved. To comply with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policy, accounts require verified deposit history meeting the configured threshold ($200+ minimum deposit requirement).

faqs.question: How does the $100 Refer & Earn Ambassador Program and Promo Media Kit work?
faqs.answer: Share your unique referral link or embed any of our 3D/HD multi-slide promotional banners and short AI/studio promotional videos with your referral code baked in. When a friend registers and completes their first qualifying deposit, you earn $100 platform credit + 2 Free Wheel Spins, while they start with $25 welcome credit.

faqs.question: Can I install forged wheels, carbon spoilers, and Alcantara Yoke steering wheels at Apex?
faqs.answer: Yes. Products ordered from our Hardware & Accessories Store—including ApexOne 21" Monoblock Forged Rims, Carbon-Ceramic Brake Kits, Dry Carbon Spoilers, and Heated Alcantara Yoke Steering Wheels—can ship globally or be scheduled for plug-and-play installation at any Apex bay.

faqs.question: What costs are included in international prize shipping & customs documentation?
faqs.answer: When shipping a won Tesla vehicle or hardware prize overseas, the invoice clearly itemizes three components: (1) Factory Processing & Export Prep Fee, (2) Customs, Title & Bill of Lading Documentation Cost, and (3) Insured International Carrier Freight based on destination country and delivery method.

faqs.question: Are coupon codes valid on Tesla purchases, wraps, and free spins?
faqs.answer: Yes! Active promo codes in our Coupons & Deals Hub—such as CYBER20 (20% off wraps & parts), TESLAPLAID ($1,000 off factory vehicles), APEXSHIP (free domestic carrier shipping), and FREESPINS5 (5 complimentary wheel spins)—apply directly at checkout.

faqs.question: Where can I view live updates via Sitemap, XML Feeds, or RSS?
faqs.answer: We publish both human-readable Site Map & RSS Feeds pages (linked directly in the footer) and machine-readable /sitemap.xml and /rss.xml endpoints updated in real time with new inventory drops, APY pool launches, and platform announcements.

faqs.question: How does the Local Currency Switcher calculate dashboard balances and vehicle prices?
faqs.answer: Open Site Settings in the navigation menu or your User Dashboard to switch display currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, AED, JPY, CHF, NGN). All converted vehicle MSRP prices and dashboard balances use live platform multipliers configured by our Treasury Admin, while underlying settlements remain transparently tracked in USD.

faqs.question: How do I claim and ship a Tesla vehicle or hardware prize won on the wheel?
faqs.answer: Open User Dashboard → Won Prizes & Shipping. Select your won vehicle, verify its assigned VIN, fill in your international or domestic street address and delivery method, and settle the itemized Processing Fee, Export Documentation Cost, and Carrier Freight directly from your spendable USD vault or via deposit.

faqs.question: Can ambassadors share multi-slide 3D banners and short promotional videos?
faqs.answer: Yes. Visit the Promo Banners & AI Videos section to preview interactive 3D/HD rotating multi-image banners and AI-generated or studio short promo videos. Every shareable link and HTML embed automatically injects your personal referral code.

faqs.question: Does Mobile Ranger dispatch cover high-voltage diagnostics, tire rotations, and brake service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our Mobile Ranger vans carry Tesla-grade diagnostic telemetry laptops, torque calibration tools, 12V/16V lithium auxiliary batteries, and HEPA cabin filter kits to service your vehicle directly at your home or office driveway.

faqs.question: How are Staking ROI and TSLA Stock ROI drops verified in the Live Community Ledger?
